method: Each native R8 W4/A and hot1/B repetition has a distinct fresh-service companion at identical offered rate, placement and duration with existing PROFILE/STATS/SERIES flags. Native qualification never uses instrumented latency. Resource CPU/WAL columns belong to original native trial; prefix and loan columns belong to its indexed companion.
prefix_clock_scope: All resolved R flights, including failed/void outcomes; aggregate committed-only commit-to-ACK distribution unavailable. See spike_r.rs 643-654 at 6c0fe17c6e.
cpu_caveat: Frozen generator lacks native measured-start timestamps: controller generator-launch anchor + 100ms scheduler lead + 10s warmup, 100ms CPU sampling/interpolation. ACK divisor includes measured-arrival completions in drain.
wal_caveat: Cluster-wide pg_stat_wal deltas span warmup, measurement, native drain and background head/lease/retention work; delayed PG statistics reporting is not a per-transaction exact measure.
sent_mean_caveat: Conservative HDR upper-equivalent service-histogram sum divided by sent requests only. Tiny expired-before-send timing intervals remain in numerator; unsent arrivals never dilute divisor.
